bands.brings: A running fountain and lifted shutters

bands.name: Recovering
bands.brings: Lit lamps, open kiosks and visitors

bands.name: Lively
bands.brings: Stall lanterns, visitors and fine goods

bands.name: Thriving
bands.brings: A travelling stall and a full square

store.greet: Take a good look. By tomorrow, every last thing will be gone.
store.shut: The bell is quiet, the shutters are down, and Pip has taken the shelf indoors.
sold: {item} is yours. I had nearly named it.
There goes {item}. The shelf looks surprised.
A fine choice: {item}. I was saving it for nobody.

board.title: Square Report
board.intro: Things break in this shared square. Walk up to fix one; every fix lifts it for everyone.
board.curse: Some nights curse the square: lamps go dark, kiosks shut, and ghosts undo things.
board.omen: Crows fill every perch, a ghost walks by daylight, and the sky is wrong at the edges.
board.night: Keep to the lit lamps. The night stall trades, and anything lying about may be taken.
board.after: The curse left dark lamps, shut doors and litter. The square needs hands today.

merchant.name: Fine Goods
merchant.greet: Rare pieces cost extra coins. They have travelled farther than the fountain water.
lines: {item} has crossed several cobbles to meet you.
A costly piece, but the crate was exceptionally stubborn.
{item} is wrapped up. The wrapping is complimentary.
That one does not visit Pip’s shelf.
Coins well spent. The stall approves.

vendor.name: Night Trading
vendor.greet: The dark makes a tidy shop. These pieces are waiting quietly.
vendor.bought: {item} is back where it can misbehave politely.
lines: {item} prefers the dark, but it will manage indoors.
A small trade for a long night.
Take {item}. Leave the moonlight where it is.
That piece has been waiting beside the monument.
The lanterns do not mind a little competition.

ghosts: The bench remembers me better than I do.
The dry fountain made a very convincing swimming pool.
I used to admire that statue. It never returned the effort.
One lamp blinked at me all evening. I blinked back.
These cobbles were warmer when I had feet.
The bench has a wobble. It is doing its best.
closed: Closed today: the coffee propeller needs a new bolt.
Closed today: lemonade jars need washing.
Closed today: the arcade has a loose floor tile.
Closed today: the post office scale is stuck.
Closed today: garden hose has a split.
Closed today: the wheel needs its handle tightened.

objects.name: Humming Waylight
objects.desc: The tall lantern hums one steady note, even with its switch off.

objects.name: Winter Campfire
objects.desc: Its flames flicker blue and give the air no warmth at all.

objects.name: Homeward Teddy
objects.desc: The teddy bear is always turned toward the road home, even after being moved.

objects.name: Unclaimed Rucksack
objects.desc: The backpack is packed full, though nobody in the square admits to dropping it.

objects.name: Everbloom Urn
objects.desc: Its white flowers never wilt, and nobody remembers putting them in the vase.

objects.name: Blinking Redcaps
objects.desc: The mushroom caps flicker like tiny lamps that cannot settle down.

objects.name: Wandering Tinwalker
objects.desc: The wind-up robot stands somewhere else each time you look back at it.

objects.name: Absent Reflection
objects.desc: The standing mirror shows the square perfectly, except for the banana before it.

objects.name: Lost-Hour Clock
objects.desc: The grandfather clock stopped at an hour the town does not have.

objects.name: Lasting Camp Lamp
objects.desc: The camp lantern hums softly and stays lit, even in a closed crate.
